- **Date Created:** 28 Apr 2025
- **Status:** In Progress
- **Priority:** High
- **Assignee:** Operations Director (A. Patil)
- **Description:** Following a security incident at a nearby shelter (unauthorized entry by a former resident), the BMC has issued a directive requiring all shelters to revise their visitor entry protocol. Key changes: (1) all visitors must register at the gate with government-issued ID; (2) visitors allowed only between 09:00 and 18:00 unless emergency; (3) shelter managers must maintain a visitor log and submit weekly summary to BMC; (4) any visitor staying overnight requires prior written approval from the Operations Director.

- 29 Apr 11:30 [LM]: Laxmi Sagar manager noted that some residents have family members who visit daily for meals. Suggested a "frequent visitor" pass system to avoid repeated registration every day.
- 29 Apr 14:00 [AP]: Incorporated both suggestions into the final protocol. Caregiver exemption will require a written request from the resident and approval from the shelter manager, valid for 7 days. Frequent visitor pass will be issued for residents' immediate family (spouse, children, parents) and valid for 30 days, renewable.
- 30 Apr 09:00 [AP]: Final protocol sent to BMC for approval. Expected response by 5 May. Until approval, shelters to continue with existing protocol but maintain stricter gate checks as per interim BMC directive.
